description.value: New York Marriott Downtown is a Lower Manhattan hotel at 85 West Street at Albany Street, New York, New York, USA, 10006. Award winning dining awaits at the New York Marriott Downtown – home to Bill’s Bar & Burger, renowned for serving some of the best burgers in the country. Its West Side Bar adds live music, inventive cocktails and a selection of regional beers. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Safe and good location. Loved the great river view and is very clean”. Representative watch-outs: “The room was tiny, and the bed was also very small”.
